Sandbox_ProjectPeople_PopulationEnabled_: Create persistent groups as you explore and continue their plans in game time. Disabling pauses new arrivals and background stories; existing people, bodies and memories remain.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_PopulationDensity_: 1 is normal: roughly four initial groups per 300 by 300 tile region in the early outbreak. Older outbreaks reveal fewer groups. 0 stops new groups. Changes affect unexplored regions and future migration; established people remain and cleared regions are not refilled.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_PopulationMode_too: Declining limits discovery by outbreak age and adds no migrants. Modest migration permits occasional new groups. Inhabited keeps initial density steady and permits more arrivals. All modes preserve known identities; migrants are distinct people, never replacements.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_MigrationDays_tool: Minimum game days between regional arrivals. 30 is normal. A safe site must be found near players. Missed intervals do not create a flood of arrivals on return; regional admission limits still apply.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_PhysicalPopulation: Stops new bodies when this many survivor bodies are loaded across the world. Default 20; higher values need performance testing. Lowering this never deletes people. Existing bodies returning with loaded chunks may exceed the limit.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_OutbreakAgeDays: Additional outbreak age at first population setup
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_OutbreakAgeDays_to: Extra days added to the game's time-since-apocalypse setting and elapsed world time when the population is first initialized. 0 follows the game; 730 adds two years. Saved outbreak history does not change if this setting is edited later.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_PopulationStories_: Groups reconsider escape, refuge, settlement and relocation in game time. Never-physical groups can travel between recorded refuge areas. Keeps saved milestones with bounded catch-up. Does not fabricate inventory, bodily changes or offscreen deaths. Disabling preserves their stories.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_LivingSurvivors_to: Survivors develop exertion strain, stress and a need for company. These affect conversation and new travel agreements. Disabling pauses these effects and keeps their memories. Does not change health, food, mortality or combat rules.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_IdleAutonomy_toolt: Idle survivors take breaks, keep watch and visit visible companions in the same room. Follow, wait, work, combat and transfer commitments take priority. Disabling does not erase personalities or memories.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_StrainRate_tooltip: Multiplier for strain from movement and danger. 0 stops accumulation; 1 is normal. Safe breaks relieve strain. This is not native hunger, fatigue or health.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_StressRate_tooltip: Multiplier for stress during observed danger. 0 stops continuous danger stress; actual injury, loss and violence still matter. 1 is normal.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_SocialRate_tooltip: Multiplier for loneliness while observed without nearby trusted company. 0 stops accumulation; 1 is normal. Sociable people feel isolation more strongly.
Sandbox_ProjectPeople_RecoveryRate_toolt: Multiplier for psychological recovery and safe rest. 1 is normal. Does not heal wounds, cure infection, restore food or grant protection.
